mapper.sql: id , tenant_id , user_id , model_id , model_name , provider_id , type , scene , input_tokens , output_tokens , total_tokens , dept_id , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt
mapper.update: update llm_model_usage set id = id where id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
insert into llm_model_usage (tenant_id , user_id , model_id , model_name , provider_id , type , scene , input_tokens , output_tokens , total_tokens , dept_id , delete_flag , created_by , created_dt , updated_by , updated_dt) values
(#{item.tenantId} , #{item.userId} , #{item.modelId} , #{item.modelName} , #{item.providerId} , #{item.type} , #{item.scene} , #{item.inputTokens} , #{item.outputTokens} , #{item.totalTokens} , #{item.deptId} , 1 , #{item.createdBy} , now() , #{item.updatedBy} , now())
mapper.select:
select type , sum(input_tokens) as inputTokens , sum(output_tokens) as outputTokens , sum(total_tokens) as totalTokens , count(1) as callCount from llm_model_usage where 1 = 1
group by type

select date_format(created_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') as dt , type , sum(total_tokens) as totalTokens , count(1) as callCount from llm_model_usage where 1 = 1
group by date_format(created_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') , type order by dt asc

select count(1) as callCount , ifnull(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens , ifnull(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens , ifnull(sum(total_tokens), 0) as totalTokens from llm_model_usage where 1 = 1

select model_id as id , max(model_name) as name , count(1) as count from llm_model_usage where 1 = 1
group by model_id order by count desc limit #{pageSize}
